snippet.title: FAWFUL IS IN MARIO KART 8
snippet.description:
I didn't make this mod, credit for that goes to BLgotswag, and SeanHicksArt for the model. I'm happy this video is able to further expose this awesome mod though, and Nintendo, you know what to do in the next Mario Kart now ;) (please though?)

Please chill with the dabbing comments.

Mod by BLgotswag (LINK UPDATED): https://gamebanana.com/skins/166496

Fawful model originally made by SeanHicksArt for this Sm4sh mod: https://gamebanana.com/skins/154279

2D artwork in thumbnail made by pizzasupper: https://pizzasupper.deviantart.com/art/Mario-Kart-1-714432593

Mod goes over Ludwig btw. Voice was added in editing this video, but the mod has since been updated to include his voice.
